note_text: Low back pain with right leg radiculopathy x 8 weeks. Completed PT for 8 weeks and NSAIDs with minimal improvement. Denies bowel/bladder incontinence. No saddle anesthesia. Prior imaging: lumbar xray inconclusive. Neuro exam: mild weakness dorsiflexion 4/5.

showcase.description: A clean lumbar MRI request with therapy duration, symptom duration, imaging context, and red-flag documentation all present.
showcase.title: Lumbar MRI ready for administrative review
showcase.why_interesting: Shows the straight-line READY path with evidence snippets across each requirement.

note_text: OSA noted in problem list. Sleep study in 2023 mentioned but no date. AHI not documented.

showcase.description: The note mentions OSA and a past sleep study, but it leaves out the date and AHI details required to determine readiness.
showcase.title: CPAP request refused for missing documentation
showcase.why_interesting: Shows refusal-first behavior when required evidence is missing instead of inferred.

note_text: Low back pain x 5 weeks. PT x 5 weeks documented. Denies weakness. Denies bowel/bladder changes. No prior imaging.

showcase.description: This note documents the right fields, but both symptom duration and therapy duration are still below threshold.
showcase.title: Documented, but not yet ready to submit
showcase.why_interesting: Shows the difference between documented failure and missingness.

note_text: Dx obstructive sleep apnea. Sleep study 2024/06/01. RDI 28. Request CPAP E0601.

showcase.description: A CPAP request that includes OSA documentation, a slash-formatted sleep study date, and an RDI value.
showcase.title: CPAP ready case with alternative date formatting
showcase.why_interesting: Shows cross-domain breadth and a small extraction robustness edge case.

note_text: Neck pain with right arm radiculopathy x 8 weeks. PT for 8 weeks and NSAIDs documented with minimal improvement. Denies weakness. Denies bowel/bladder changes. Prior cervical xray inconclusive.

showcase.description: A second spine MRI procedure that uses the same deterministic evidence contract as lumbar MRI.
showcase.title: Cervical MRI ready case using the new supported pathway
showcase.why_interesting: Shows that the shared service and rule registry can support new deterministic procedures without changing the engine shape.

note_text: Right knee pain with locking and catching x 8 weeks. Completed PT for 8 weeks and NSAIDs with minimal improvement. Prior knee xray normal/unremarkable.

showcase.description: A non-spine advanced imaging request that stays narrow: symptom duration, therapy duration, prior xray context, and explicit mechanical symptom review.
showcase.title: Knee MRI ready case with explicit mechanical symptoms
showcase.why_interesting: Shows deeper deterministic product coverage without changing the engine shape or widening into clinical scoring.
